title: Analysis of Apoptosis by AnnexinPE/7-AAD Staining
author: Mengchen Shi
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kcecste

steps.title: Plate cells and induce apoptosis
steps.instruction: Plate 1 × 10^5 cells per well in 6‑well plates and incubate for 48 h under serum‑free conditions to induce spontaneous apoptosis.

steps.title: Harvest and wash cells
steps.instruction: Collect the cells by centrifugation, discard the supernatant, and wash the cell pellet with cold PBS.

steps.title: Resuspend cells and add stains
steps.instruction: Resuspend the washed cells in 500 µL of 1× Binding Buffer, then add 5 µL Annexin PE and 5 µL 7‑AAD (Keygentec, Nanjing, China).

steps.title: Incubate stained cells
steps.instruction: Incubate the cell suspension at room temperature for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Analyze by flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Detect the samples using a flow cytometer to determine the fractions of apoptotic cells.
